Drink N’ Draw Featuring a Live Cosplay Model

Sunday
November 15
2026
Location: Amphitheater
Time: 1pm to 3pm

Unleash your creativity and bring your artistic skills to life during this fun, interactive figure-drawing experience!

Artists of all skill levels are invited to practice their traditional drawing techniques while sketching a live model dressed in cosplay. Whether you’re an experienced artist or just looking to try something new, this is a great opportunity to experiment with poses, proportions, and creative expression in a welcoming environment. Enjoy trivia, compete for prizes, and connect with fellow art enthusiasts for an afternoon of creativity and fun. A suggested donation of $10 is encouraged.

What to Know Before You Go:
Parking on-site will be limited due to construction on the I-95 CAP. However, there are many great ways to access the Waterfront, including walking and biking along the Delaware River Trail, rideshare, and public transit. To ensure a seamless visit, guests can visit the Know Before You Go guide for parking recommendations, directions, FAQs, and more.
